findings.title: Preview registry cleanup may use zero token; window context wrongly nested
findings.message: The goroutine can return before the start callback assigns token, in which case the cleanup deletes events[0] and leaks the real registry entry. runDocumentPanel also wraps ctx (itself an alertWindowContext) as the 'window' field, so exact-parent revocation may not use the real parent context. The preview loop also runs on the caller, but done is drained only after pending events are processed. The select can pick events over done, which is acceptable but not deterministic.
findings.suggestion: Set the token in a local variable that is guaranteed to be set (for example, register before starting, or delete via a defer inside the start closure). Pass the actual parent context as window.
findings.evidence: value, err := nativeOperationRun(alertWindowContext{Context: child, window: ctx}, func(id uint64) {
